{{Short description|Argentine mathematician}}
'''Ana María Patricia Fauring''' is an Argentine mathematician who won the [[Paul Erdős Award]] for being "the principal mathematician involved in training Argentine teams for the [[International Mathematical Olympiad|IMO]] and other international events, where they have done respectably".<ref>{{cite web|url=http://wfnmc.org/erdfauring.html|title=Patricia Fauring, Argentina|publisher=World Federation of National Mathematics Competitions|access-date=2019-04-19}}</ref>

Fauring obtained her PhD in 1982 from the [[University of Buenos Aires]] under the supervision of Ángel Rafael Larotonda. Her thesis was titled ''Una noción de estabilidad para campos vectoriales complejos'' (''A notion of stability for complex vector fields'').<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=160151}}</ref>
